blocks.text: The shared machine screen gives different machines a common layout, but the program decides which slots are valid. Do not treat every visible inventory slot as an interchangeable input.

rows: The labelled input area; special programs may reserve particular slots.
The special slot, internally 20; its role depends on the machine.
Speed, Energy, Transfer and Void where supported.

blocks.text: A completed batch can put results in retained overflow while normal outputs are blocked. Ordinary operation waits rather than discarding those results. The Void Upgrade is the explicit exception: it permits overflow disposal.

Automatic side mode follows the machine role. Input, Output and Disabled override a face. External item pipes and the Transfer Upgrade must both obey the machine automation master switch and those side modes. Energy has its own capability and direction settings.

rows: Confirm the slot label and accepted ingredient, including any analysed/stable circuit requirement.
Test with no redstone signal unless the machine specifically needs one.
Empty outputs and retained overflow before assuming the recipe is broken.
Use Sides or the wrench to select the intended input and output faces.
